format: html

# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pROC)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")

# Palette
Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#4B988F",
  "Severely impaired immunity"  = "#EABBBB",
  "More preserved immunity"     = "#C89A1B",
  "Elite controller"            = "#5A588B"
)

set_colors <- Subgroup_colors

# Levels
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Normal", "Low", "Very low")

subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

# Set cut-off
fdr_cutoff <- 0.5
```

# Figure 2

## Figure 2A

```{r}
cd4cd8_baseline <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`)) %>%
  mutate(
    status   = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (baseline)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, status)

# Calculate totals
subgroup_totals <- cd4cd8_baseline %>%
  group_by(Subgroup) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# Create label vector that preserves subgroup names
subgroup_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(subgroup_totals$Subgroup, " (n=", subgroup_totals$total, ")"),
  subgroup_totals$Subgroup
)

# Plot
p_cd4cd8_baseline <- ggplot(cd4cd8_baseline,
                            aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count status",
    values = c(
      "Very low" = "#d95f02",
      "Low"      = "grey80",
      "Normal"   = "#1b9e77"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = subgroup_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline CD4/CD8 T-cell count status by HIV-1 subgroup",
    x = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    fill = "CD4/CD8 Status"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv()

p_cd4cd8_baseline
```

## Figure 2B

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide_ml |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |> filter(Disease == "HIV"))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_baseline_subgroup <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Subgroup)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_convexhull(
    aes(fill = Subgroup, colour = Subgroup),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors,
                     name = "HIV-1 subgroup") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = Subgroup_colors,
                    name = "HIV-1 subgroup") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count ratio"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Principal component analysis of the HIV-1 baseline plasma proteome",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  coord_equal()

p_pca_baseline_subgroup
```

```{r}
# Save PCA variance and loadings for Figure 2B
fig2b_pca <- pca_df$pca_variance |> mutate(Figure = "Figure 2B") |> mutate(Groups = "HIV (baseline)")
fig2b_pca |> write_xlsx("../tables/PCA/fig2b_pca_variance.xlsx")

fig2b_pca_contribution <- pca_df$pca_loadings |> mutate(Figure = "Figure 2B") |> mutate(Comparison = "HIV (baseline)") |>
  # select the top 15 terms from PC1 and PC2
  group_by(component) |> slice_max(order_by = abs(value), n = 15) |> ungroup() |> filter(component %in% c("PC1", "PC2"))
fig2b_pca_contribution |> write_xlsx("../tables/PCA/fig2b_pca_loadings.xlsx")
```

## Figure 2C

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease %in% c("HIV", "Healthy")) |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |> 
  filter(Subgroup != "Elite controller") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "PLWH (at baseline) vs Healthy",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy <- de_results$de_res

p_hiv_baseline_healthy <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  )

p_hiv_baseline_healthy$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p_hiv_baseline_healthy$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p_hiv_baseline_healthy$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p_hiv_baseline_healthy

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC > 0.5) |> nrow()
de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy |> filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05, logFC < -0.5) |> nrow()
```

## Figure 2D

```{r}
highlighted_proteins <- de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy |>
  filter(logFC > 0.5) |>
  arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy |>
      filter(logFC < -0.5) |>
      arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
      slice_head(n = 5)
  ) |>
  pull(Feature)

desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Elite controller",
  "Healthy"
)

p_plwh_baseline_boxplot <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Feature, NPX) %>%
  right_join(
    metadata %>% filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up"),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Feature %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subgroup %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature       = factor(Feature, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = desired_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x     = Subgroup,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subgroup,
    fill  = Subgroup
  )) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      alpha  = 0.7,
      stroke = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Feature, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
        scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors,
                       name = "HIV-1 subgroup / Cohort") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors,
                      name = "HIV-1 subgroup / Cohort") +
    labs(
      title = "Top 10 most significantly increased and top 5 most significantly decreased proteins in PLWH at baseline vs healthy controls",
      x     = "HIV-1 subgroup / Cohort",
      y     = "NPX"
    ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  # remove x-axis text
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )

p_plwh_baseline_boxplot
```

## Figure 2E

Run Supplementary first!

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Combine all result tables
# --------------------------------------------------

all_res <- list(
  PHI = res_phi_healthy,
  SII = res_sii_healthy,
  MPI = res_mpi_healthy,
  EC  = res_ec_healthy_baseline
) |>
  imap_dfr(~ .x |> mutate(Comparison = .y))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Classify significance
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- all_res |>
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("PHI", "SII", "MPI", "EC")),
    Significance = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0.5  ~ "Significant increased",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Significant decreased",
      TRUE                            ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Comparison, Significance) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot stacked barplot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_bar_subgroup_baseline_healthy <- plot_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Comparison, y = n, fill = Significance)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Significant increased" = "#C03830",
    "Significant decreased" = "#317EC2",
    "Not significant" = "grey80"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant proteins & logFC > 0.5 across HIV-1 subgroups",
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "Number of proteins",
    fill = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_hiv()

p_bar_subgroup_baseline_healthy
```

## Figure 2F

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define result list (reversed order)
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list_healthy <- list(
  `EC vs. Healthy`  = res_ec_healthy_baseline,
  `MPI vs. Healthy` = res_mpi_healthy,
  `SII vs. Healthy` = res_sii_healthy,
  `PHI vs. Healthy` = res_phi_healthy
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract significantly increased proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

up_sets <- lapply(res_list_healthy, function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      logFC > 0.5
    ) |>
    pull(Feature)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sanity check
# --------------------------------------------------

message("Proteins per set:")
print(sapply(up_sets, length))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert list to UpSet matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

up_mat <- UpSetR::fromList(up_sets)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save UpSet plot
# --------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/upset_increased_proteins_sii_mpi_phi_ec_healthy.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  onefile = FALSE
)

print(
  upset(
  up_mat,
  sets = names(up_sets),
  order.by = "freq",
  empty.intersections = "off",
  keep.order = TRUE,
  sets.bar.color = set_colors,
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of proteins",
  sets.x.label = "Proteins per comparison",
  text.scale = c(2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)
)

dev.off()
```

## Figure 2G

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define result list (reversed order)
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list_healthy <- list(
  `EC vs. Healthy`  = res_ec_healthy_baseline,
  `MPI vs. Healthy` = res_mpi_healthy,
  `SII vs. Healthy` = res_sii_healthy,
  `PHI vs. Healthy` = res_phi_healthy
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract significantly decreased proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

down_sets <- lapply(res_list_healthy, function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      logFC < -0.5
    ) |>
    pull(Feature)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sanity check
# --------------------------------------------------

message("Proteins per set:")
print(sapply(down_sets, length))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert list to UpSet matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

down_mat <- UpSetR::fromList(down_sets)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save UpSet plot
# --------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/upset_decreased_proteins_sii_mpi_phi_ec_healthy.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  onefile = FALSE
)

print(
  upset(
    down_mat,
    sets = names(down_sets),
    order.by = "freq",
    empty.intersections = "off",
    keep.order = TRUE,
    nintersects = NA,
    sets.bar.color = set_colors,
    mainbar.y.label = "Number of proteins",
    sets.x.label = "Proteins per comparison",
    text.scale = c(2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3)
  )
)

dev.off()
```

# Supplementary Figure 2

## Figure S2A

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |> 
  filter(Subgroup %in% c("Primary HIV infection", "Healthy")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "Primary HIV-1 infection (at baseline) vs. Healthy",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_phi_healthy <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  ) +
  xlim(c(-2.5, 5))

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_phi_baseline_healthy <- p
```

```{r}
# Figure (S2A + S2B) / (S2C + S2D)
p_supplementary_2 <- (p_volcano_phi_baseline_healthy + p_volcano_sii_baseline_healthy) /
  (p_volcano_mpi_baseline_healthy + p_volcano_ec_baseline_healthy) +
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup)
  )

input_data <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Function to check valid split
# --------------------------------------------------

valid_split <- function(split_obj) {

  train_groups <- unique(split_obj$train_data$Subgroup)
  test_groups  <- unique(split_obj$test_data$Subgroup)

  all_levels <- levels(input_metadata$Subgroup)

  all(all_levels %in% train_groups) &&
    all(all_levels %in% test_groups)
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Run multiple safe splits
# --------------------------------------------------

n_splits <- 100
model_results <- list()
split_objects <- list()

i <- 1
seed <- 1

while (i <= n_splits) {

  message("Trying split with seed ", seed)

  split_candidate <- hd_split_data(
    hd_obj,
    variable = "Subgroup",
    ratio = 0.7,
    seed = seed
  )

  if (valid_split(split_candidate)) {

    message("✓ Valid split found")

    split_objects[[i]] <- split_candidate

    model_results[[i]] <- hd_model_rreg(
      dat = split_candidate,
      variable = "Subgroup",
      case = NULL,
      balance_groups = FALSE,  # IMPORTANT
      cor_threshold = 1,
      grid_size = 30,
      cv_sets = 5,
      mixture = 1,
      palette = NULL,
      plot_y_labels = TRUE,
      verbose = FALSE,
      seed = seed
    )

    i <- i + 1
  }

  seed <- seed + 1
}

names(model_results) <- paste0("split_", seq_len(n_splits))
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract feature importance from all splits
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {

    model$features |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)

  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Remove zero importance features
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  filter(Scaled_Importance > 0)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compute how many splits each protein appears in
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  group_by(Class, Feature) |>
  mutate(
    n_selected = n_distinct(Split)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Keep proteins selected >5 times
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  filter(n_selected > 5)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Identify top proteins per class
# --------------------------------------------------

top_features <- feature_importance_df |>
  group_by(Class, Feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(Scaled_Importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(Class) |>
  slice_max(mean_importance, n = 15)

plot_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  semi_join(top_features, by = c("Class", "Feature"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create labels with selection frequency
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = paste0(Feature, " (n=", n_selected, ")")
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Order features by median importance
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_order <- plot_df |>
  group_by(Feature_label) |>
  summarise(
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_importance) |>
  pull(Feature_label)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = factor(Feature_label, levels = feature_order)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_feature_stability <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Feature_label,
    y = Scaled_Importance,
    fill = Class
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Class, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Protein importance stability across model splits",
    x = "Protein",
    y = "Scaled feature importance",
    fill = "HIV subgroup"
  )

p_feature_stability

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save figure
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Feature_importance_stability_across_splits_scaled.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/model/",
  plot     = p_feature_stability,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Feature_importance_stability_across_splits_scaled.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/model/",
  plot     = p_feature_stability,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 10
)

multivariate_lasso_baseline <- plot_df
```

## Figure S5B

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract ROC curves from all splits
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    
    model$roc_curve$data |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
    
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_clean <- roc_all |>
  select(.level, Split, specificity, sensitivity) |>
  filter(!is.na(specificity), !is.na(sensitivity)) |>
  group_by(.level, Split, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.level, Split, specificity)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Interpolation grid
# --------------------------------------------------

spec_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Interpolate ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_interp <- roc_clean |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  group_modify(~{

    df <- arrange(.x, specificity)

    approx_res <- approx(
      x = df$specificity,
      y = df$sensitivity,
      xout = spec_grid,
      rule = 2
    )

    tibble(
      specificity = approx_res$x,
      sensitivity = approx_res$y
    )

  }) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Mean ROC curve
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_mean <- roc_interp |>
  group_by(.level, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    mean_sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Compute AUC per split
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_df <- roc_interp |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  summarise(
    auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(1 - specificity, sensitivity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Mean AUC + 95% CI
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_summary <- auc_df |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    lower_ci = quantile(auc, 0.025),
    upper_ci = quantile(auc, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

p_roc_mean <- ggplot(
  roc_mean,
  aes(
    x = 1 - specificity,
    y = mean_sensitivity,
    colour = .level
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~.level) +
  geom_text(
    data = auc_summary,
    aes(
      x = 0.6,
      y = 0.1,
      label = paste0(
        "AUC = ",
        round(mean_auc, 2),
        " (",
        round(lower_ci, 2),
        "–",
        round(upper_ci, 2),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    colour = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Mean ROC curves across model splits"
  )

p_roc_mean

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Mean_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup.pdf",
  p_roc_mean,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Mean_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup.png",
  p_roc_mean,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)
```

### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    model$roc_curve$data |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_clean <- roc_all |>
  select(.level, Split, specificity, sensitivity) |>
  filter(!is.na(specificity), !is.na(sensitivity)) |>
  group_by(.level, Split, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.level, Split, specificity)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Interpolate ROC curves (smooth lines)
# --------------------------------------------------

spec_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

roc_interp <- roc_clean |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  group_modify(~{
    
    df <- arrange(.x, specificity)
    
    approx_res <- approx(
      x = df$specificity,
      y = df$sensitivity,
      xout = spec_grid,
      rule = 2
    )
    
    tibble(
      specificity = approx_res$x,
      sensitivity = approx_res$y
    )
    
  }) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract AUC (REMOVE macro/micro)
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    
    model$metrics$auc |>
      rename(.level = Subgroup, auc = AUC) |>
      filter(!.level %in% c("macro", "micro")) |>   # 🔑 FIX
      mutate(Split = split_name)
    
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Median AUC + IQR
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_summary <- auc_df |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  summarise(
    median_auc = median(auc),
    q1_auc     = quantile(auc, 0.25),
    q3_auc     = quantile(auc, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Select median split per subgroup
# --------------------------------------------------

median_split <- auc_df |>
  left_join(auc_summary, by = ".level") |>
  mutate(diff = abs(auc - median_auc)) |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  slice_min(diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(.level, Split)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Get ROC curves for median splits ONLY
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_median <- roc_interp |>
  inner_join(median_split, by = c(".level", "Split"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_roc_median <- ggplot(
  roc_median,
  aes(
    x = 1 - specificity,
    y = sensitivity,
    colour = .level
  )
) +

  # 🔘 All splits (background)
  geom_line(
    data = roc_interp,
    aes(
      x = 1 - specificity,
      y = sensitivity,
      group = interaction(Split, .level)
    ),
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # 🔵 Median ROC (foreground)
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~.level) +

  geom_text(
    data = auc_summary,
    aes(
      x = 0.6,
      y = 0.1,
      label = paste0(
        "AUC = ",
        round(median_auc, 2),
        " (",
        round(q1_auc, 2),
        "–",
        round(q3_auc, 2),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    colour = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Median ROC curves per HIV subgroup",
    subtitle = "Grey = all splits, Color = median split, numbers = median (IQR)"
  )

p_roc_median

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Median_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup.pdf",
  p_roc_median,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Median_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup.png",
  p_roc_median,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Extract metrics per split
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {

    # ---------------------------
    # AUC (per subgroup)
    # ---------------------------
    auc_df <- model$metrics$auc |>
      rename(Subgroup = Subgroup, AUC = AUC)

    # ---------------------------
    # Other metrics (single values)
    # ---------------------------
    accuracy    <- model$metrics$accuracy
    sensitivity <- model$metrics$sensitivity
    specificity <- model$metrics$specificity

    # ---------------------------
    # Combine
    # ---------------------------
    auc_df |>
      mutate(
        Split       = split_name,
        Accuracy    = accuracy,
        Sensitivity = sensitivity,
        Specificity = specificity
      )

  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Optional: remove macro/micro
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df_clean <- metrics_df |>
  filter(!Subgroup %in% c("macro", "micro"))

metrics_df_clean
metrics_df_clean |> write_xlsx("../tables/Multivariate_LASSO/Supplementary Table 11.xlsx")

summary_df <- metrics_df_clean |>
  group_by(Subgroup) |>
  summarise(
    median_auc = median(AUC),
    q1_auc     = quantile(AUC, 0.25),
    q3_auc     = quantile(AUC, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_df
summary_df |> write_xlsx("../tables/Multivariate_LASSO/Supplementary Table 12.xlsx")

ggplot(metrics_df_clean, aes(x = Subgroup, y = AUC, fill = Subgroup)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv()
```

```{r}
df_baseline <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  select(DAid, ID, Timepoint, Subgroup, BMI_bl = `BMI (baseline)`) |>
  inner_join(
    data_wide |> select(DAid, LEP_Baseline = LEP),
    by = "DAid"
  )

df_fu <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == "Follow-up") |>
  select(DAid, ID, Timepoint, Subgroup, BMI_fu = `BMI (follow-up)`) |>
  inner_join(
    data_wide |> select(DAid, LEP_Followup = LEP),
    by = "DAid"
  )

df <- df_baseline |>
  inner_join(df_fu, by = c("ID")) |>
  mutate(
    BMI_delta = BMI_fu - BMI_bl,
    LEP_delta = LEP_Followup - LEP_Baseline
  ) |>
  select(
    ID,
    Subgroup = Subgroup.x,
    BMI_bl,
    BMI_fu,
    BMI_delta,
    LEP_Baseline,
    LEP_Followup,
    LEP_delta
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot helper
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_scatter <- function(data, x, y, title, subtitle_text, xlab, ylab) {

  cor_res <- cor.test(
    data[[x]], data[[y]],
    method = "spearman",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )

  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], fill = Subgroup)) +
    
    geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = 1),
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
    
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        subtitle_text,
        "\nrho = ", round(cor_res$estimate, 2),
        ", p = ", signif(cor_res$p.value, 2)
      ),
      x = xlab,
      y = ylab,
      fill = "HIV-1 subgroup"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create plots
# --------------------------------------------------

# Baseline
p1 <- plot_scatter(
  df, "BMI_bl", "LEP_Baseline",
  "BMI vs LEP",
  "At baseline",

# Follow-up

  "LEP (follow-up, NPX)"
)

# ΔBMI vs ΔLEP (NEW)

plot_final <- (p1 | p2) /
```
